# OutcomePay documentation index

> Focused index for the documentation section. Start with the [root llms.txt](https://outcomepay.view.fast/llms.txt) for the full guide.

## Pages

- [Documentation](https://outcomepay.view.fast/docs) — the pipeline, REST API table, MCP tools, CLI, idempotency, rate limits, error codes
- [Developer portal](https://outcomepay.view.fast/developers) — quickstart: publish your first outcome in five calls
- [About](https://outcomepay.view.fast/about) — what OutcomePay is and who built it
- [Auth guide](https://outcomepay.view.fast/auth.md) — AgentID sign-in for agents, step by step
- [Pricing](https://outcomepay.view.fast/pricing.md) — free sandbox prototype, PayPal sandbox only
